name: @opaque/backend
description: Opaque V1 — relay mesh (§5) and CRE confidential execution. Swarnim, S3/S4.
comment: Runs .ts directly: Node >=22.18 strips types natively, so there is no build
step and no bundler here. The engines floor is that, not a preference.
ML-KEM is NOT in Node 22's crypto (checked: generateKeyPairSync('ml-kem768')
throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE even on OpenSSL 3.6.3), and browsers have no
ML-KEM at all. The client builds its own onion layers, so the KEM must be a
library used identically on both sides or the two ends disagree on bytes.
That is why @noble/post-quantum is a dependency and not an accident.
`test` is offline and deterministic. `test:chain` reads the LIVE Arc
deployment, which is the only way to catch an ABI that has drifted from the
deployed bytecode — but it needs a network, so it is a separate script
rather than something that turns CI red when an RPC has a bad minute.
